dispositions.rationale: State portable rules completely before labeled examples; apply the same rule to local adoption text.
Name the observation unit and population. Suite, group or container evidence cannot establish a claim about each member without a proven mapping.

Use controlled before/after or isolated reconstruction when safe and meaningful. Preserve user work and first-failure evidence; do not replay a spent or forbidden capture. If the contrast cannot be obtained, state the attribution gap. No mandatory one-minute timing claim.
State the competing hypotheses in domain-free terms and choose evidence that separates them; label the toolchain example as an illustration.
Retain the scoped enumeration and classify each candidate before claiming absence, uniqueness or a defect count. Hits are a population, not automatically defects.

Consult prior adjudications and explain differences in source revision, scope, evidence or contract. History raises the burden of proof but does not immunize a demonstrated old error against correction.

Do not require an immediate unconditional yes without rechecking. Stand behind the recorded scope, revision, evidence and named gaps; new evidence or a changed context can justify re-audit and correction. Confidence is not verification.

Review prose, the measured quantity and each named instance separately. Evaluate the original claim under its recorded scope and conditions. Exact instance and contract claims require exact evidence; judgment tolerances must be stated and justified before comparison.

Fixed-input censuses should reproduce exactly. Changed populations, predicates, instruments or environments must be identified. Runtime measurements can be stochastic and still need intervals and sampling; being emitted by a command does not make a quantity deterministic.

Keep contract values and named identities exact; do not silently substitute a nearby value. Qualitative estimates may have an explicit justified tolerance. Preserve decision 0074 incidental-numeral exclusions while retaining their exact semantic contracts.
Use source-input language instead of grammar-specific language; preserve the requirement to bind the producing instrument as well as every artifact input.

Do not import another director's assent or deployment measurements as FSMGen authority. Reference examples remain labeled external illustrations; no unobserved local outcome, cost or support claim is adopted.

limits: Mechanical coverage proves source/diff identity and a declared disposition for each changed hunk; it does not prove semantic judgment or policy implementation.
